youtube.title: Velcro Was Invented Because Of A Dog 🐕 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Velcro exists because of a dog's walk.

In 1941 Swiss engineer George de Mestral found burrs stuck to his dog after a hike, studied them under a microscope, saw tiny hooks catching loops, and copied the idea. He named it Velcro, from velours and crochet.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
